payload.core_mechanism_summary: Iterate c from 1..n, b from c/2..c, compute a=c^b, check a<b, a≤n, a+b>c.
payload.rationale: Code performs a complete search over (b,c) pairs, using a=c^b to satisfy XOR condition. The search is pruned by bounding b to ensure a<b. No genuine backtracking, but this is the closest complete_search subtype.
